title: Pre-Trained Language Models as Zero-Shot Tools for Social Science Research

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating differential algorithmic performance by comparing classification accuracy, precision, recall, and discrimination (AUC) metrics across various self-reported racial and ethnic groups (e.g., White, Black, Hispanic, Asian) using voter registration data.

Measuring the neighborhood-income and education gradient in algorithmic misclassification by regressing the probability of a minority individual being incorrectly classified as White against ZCTA and census-tract socioeconomic indicators.
